tests.skips: Optional local-model checks; no model download needed.

checks: Matched elapsed timing is collected with gesture variations enabled, even when suppression and extended endings are disabled.
The full group begins at the configured cutoff; missing or unusable timing uses original 0.
Session, gesture and timing-group histories alternate independently with bounded retention.
Muted, cancelled, suppressed, duplicate and stale cues do not consume choices; admitted playback failures can.
Custom phrase changes drop inherited groups; explicit partitions are complete replacements and ungrouped palettes do not inherit stock roles.
Grouping metadata leaves every waveform unchanged across default and session voices and optional extended endings.
Four distinct finite, RMS-matched, peak-limited choices retain descending done and ascending answer motifs.
All 48 individual preview WAVs and seven original-comparison/sampler WAVs are unchanged from the prior gallery.
Six duration-guided sequences use choices [0,0,2,3,1,3,1,2], share exact A/B onsets, and match individual clip PCM.
All 61 preview WAV URLs return HTTP 200 and expected lengths; browser shows roles, elapsed-time explanations and missing-timing examples without autoplay.
listening_limit: Signal checks establish numerical properties, not human recognition or musical preference.

selection_policy.within_group: Deterministic alternation per session and gesture, after playback admission.
selection_policy.unknown_timing: Original variation 0; no group cursor advances.
selection_policy.long_turn_extension: Independent optional setting; remains disabled by default.
